info.title: BLS Legal & Governance Platform API (reverse-engineered)
info.description: Reverse-engineered from the Next.js frontend's services/api-sdk client (github.com/Parisius/BLS), not from the real backend or any backend source. Field names/types/required-ness are best-effort inferences from how the frontend builds requests and parses `{ data: ... }` responses. Verify against the real backend before treating this as an authoritative contract.
